descriptions.zh:
调用本接口可删除直播流粒度的封禁配置。
## QPS限制
本接口的单用户QPS限制为50次/秒。超过限制，API调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。
descriptions.en:
You can call this operation to delete a stream-level block configuration.

## QPS limits

You can call this operation up to 50 times per second per account. Requests that exceed this limit are dropped and you may experience service interruptions.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun live delete-live-stream-block --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --domain-name example.com --app-name liveApp0000 --stream-name liveStream0000 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun live DeleteLiveStreamBlock --region cn-hangzhou --StreamName liveStream0000 --DomainName 'example.com' --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --AppName liveApp0000
